# Each letter is a single pen pass with retracing of the earlier stems.
# Control points for the arches and terminal; dimensions are target image pixels.
def bez(a,b,c,d,n=30):
 t=np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None];return (1-t)**3*a+3*(1-t)**2*t*b+3*(1-t)*t*t*c+t**3*d

def paths(p,kind):
 p=np.asarray(p).reshape(-1,2)
 # 0 entry, 1 head, 2 bottom, 3 branch, 4-6 arch controls & crest,
 # 7-9 arch second cubic, 10 bottom, 11-13 finish controls & exit
 if kind=='i':
  return [np.array([p[0],p[1],p[2]]),bez(p[2],p[3],p[4],p[5]),np.array([p[5],p[6]])]
 return [np.array([p[0],p[1],p[2],p[3]]),bez(p[3],p[4],p[5],p[6]),bez(p[6],p[7],p[8],p[9]),np.array([p[9],p[10]]),bez(p[10],p[11],p[12],p[13]),np.array([p[13],p[14]])]

# m is made from initial stem, two arches; its middle downstroke is retraced.
def mpath(p):
 p=np.asarray(p).reshape(-1,2)
 return [np.array([p[0],p[1],p[2],p[3]]),bez(p[3],p[4],p[5],p[6]),bez(p[6],p[7],p[8],p[9]),np.array([p[9],p[10],p[11]]),bez(p[11],p[12],p[13],p[14]),bez(p[14],p[15],p[16],p[17]),np.array([p[17],p[18]]),bez(p[18],p[19],p[20],p[21]),np.array([p[21],p[22]])]

mp=np.array([[334,475],[344.3,464.4],[336.8,556.6],[342.5,491], [348,474],[357,467],[363.5,467.1], [376,466],[379.5,479],[377,500], [372,556.6],[377.7,491], [383,474],[392,467],[398.8,467.1], [411.3,466],[414.8,479],[412.3,500], [407.4,543], [405.4,556],[410,557.8],[415.8,553.1], [423.6,548.9]])
ip=np.array([[447.8,475],[458.8,464.4],[451,543], [449,556],[453.5,557.8],[459.3,553.1],[467.1,548.9]])
np0=np.concatenate([mp[:10],mp[18:]])
np0[10:]+=np.array([-35.3,0]); np0+=np.array([153,0])
S=3;R=9.015;minor=.9015;ang=np.deg2rad(-35)
rot=np.array([[np.cos(ang),-np.sin(ang)],[np.sin(ang),np.cos(ang)]])
ell=np.stack([R*np.cos(np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,40)),minor*np.sin(np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,40))],axis=1)@rot.T

def render(ps,box,scale=S):
 x0,y0,x1,y1=box
 im=Image.new('L',((x1-x0)*scale,(y1-y0)*scale));d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 # Draw connected nib footprints, convex quads around successive points and ellipses.
 for path in ps:
  # use convex swept ellipse polygons via angular order hull
  for a,b in zip(path[:-1],path[1:]):
   delta=b-a
   cross=ell[:,0]*delta[1]-ell[:,1]*delta[0]
   points=np.where((cross>=0)[:,None],ell+a,ell+b)
   coords=((points-[x0,y0])*scale).reshape(-1).tolist()
   d.polygon(coords,fill=255)
  for p in [path[0],path[-1]]:
   d.polygon(((ell+p-[x0,y0])*scale).reshape(-1).tolist(),fill=255)

def fit(p,kind,box,name):

"""RoboPaint minim: exact action record for the single, completed episode.

The lettering was reconstructed from /app/target.png as five natural broad-nib
letter paths and two dot strokes. Earlier stems are retraced within each m/n.
No filling paths are used. Calibration consists of a straight downstroke and
one m on the practice sheet. All commanded arrays are preserved beside this
file, in the order listed in executed.jsonl.

This file does not reset the robot and refuses to repeat motion in an episode
that has already moved. The active episode's authoritative record is retained
by the service. Running this file again in that episode only reports status.
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def main():
    robot = Robot()
    status = robot.status()
    if status.get('control_steps', 0) != 0:
        print('Existing episode; no motion repeated.', status)
        return
    # Initial lifted travel exposed the paper and well for camera measurements.
    robot.submit('ee_pose', [[-.30, 0, .15, 0, 1, 0, 0]] * 10,
                 dt=.2, video='none')
    # The well was located from calibrated RGB/depth, at x=-.1, y=.15.
    dip = ([[-.1, .15, .10, 0, 1, 0, 0]] * 8
           + [[-.1, .15, .025, 0, 1, 0, 0]] * 8
           + [[-.1, .15, .10, 0, 1, 0, 0]] * 8)
    robot.submit('ee_pose', dip, dt=.2, video='none')
    for line in (ROOT / 'executed.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        entry = json.loads(line)
        actions = np.load(ROOT / (entry['name'] + '_actions.npy'))
        result = robot.submit(entry['kind'], actions, dt=entry['dt'],
                              video='none', note=entry['note'])
        if result.stopped:
            raise RuntimeError('Partial call: inspect the recorded robot status before continuing.')
    print(robot.status())

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
